_notes: Silverpine dungeon boss loot (2026-10-23): Widow's Lair, Ambermill Tower, Shadowfang Keep. ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make).

Broodmother Silka.name: Brood-Fang Stiletto
Broodmother Silka.flavor_text: A single fang of the first brood, set in a handle of silk-wound bone. It remembers the hunt.

Broodmother Silka.name: Egg-Sac Sash
Broodmother Silka.flavor_text: Soft, sticky and unexpectedly strong. Do not ask what is still in the knots.

Broodmother Silka.name: Web-Spun Mantle
Broodmother Silka.flavor_text: Silk drawn thin as breath and wound by something with eight opinions.

Broodmother Silka.name: Broodmother's Hatchling Locket
Broodmother Silka.flavor_text: A locket of amber with a tiny, motionless thing inside. It is only asleep.

Weaver Skitter.name: Silk-Wrapped Knuckles
Weaver Skitter.flavor_text: Layered web hardened into a fist. It pulls back slightly every time you throw it.

Weaver Skitter.name: Weaver's Chitin Greaves
Weaver Skitter.flavor_text: Segmented, glossy, and a little too flexible at the knee.

Weaver Skitter.name: Gossamer Cowl
Weaver Skitter.flavor_text: A cowl of silk so fine you can see through it, and so can everything else.

Weaver Skitter.name: Venomfang Signet
Weaver Skitter.flavor_text: A fang bent into a ring. It stays warm on the finger.

Matriarch Velaxis.name: Widow's Spire
Matriarch Velaxis.flavor_text: A staff of stacked, silk-bound vertebrae. It hums when anything walks near the web.

Matriarch Velaxis.name: Matriarch's Carapace Cuirass
Matriarch Velaxis.flavor_text: Black plate grown rather than forged. It has opinions about being worn.

Matriarch Velaxis.name: Spinneret Gloves
Matriarch Velaxis.flavor_text: Glossy leather with a faint spiral pattern. Your fingers will leave silk behind.

Matriarch Velaxis.name: Shroud of Eight Eyes
Matriarch Velaxis.flavor_text: A cloak that never quite hangs the same way twice. It is looking around.

Magister Hawren.name: Hawren's Archive Staff
Magister Hawren.flavor_text: Capped in a violet gem the shape of a closed book. It occasionally reads aloud.

Magister Hawren.name: Gallery-Warden's Hauberk
Magister Hawren.flavor_text: Dalaran mail with a library's worth of tiny sigils beaten into every link.

Magister Hawren.name: Scholar's Quilted Cuffs
Magister Hawren.flavor_text: Cuffs stitched with a footnote that never ends.

Magister Hawren.name: Quill of the Archivist
Magister Hawren.flavor_text: A long feather-quill, still wet. It writes your name, and then does not stop.

Apothecary Helbrim.name: Helbrim's Flask-Mace
Apothecary Helbrim.flavor_text: A heavy glass mace, brimful of something that keeps almost, but never quite, boiling over.

Apothecary Helbrim.name: Alchemist's Splash-Apron
Apothecary Helbrim.flavor_text: Treated leather, stained in fourteen incompatible colours.

Apothecary Helbrim.name: Reagent-Stained Gloves
Apothecary Helbrim.flavor_text: Yellow at the fingertips, green at the knuckles, and never washed.

Apothecary Helbrim.name: Alembic Signet
Apothecary Helbrim.flavor_text: A ring that is also a tiny still. A drop condenses at the bezel every few hours.

Apothecary Helbrim.name: Thornhide Gauntlet-Claw
Apothecary Helbrim.flavor_text: The thorns face inward as often as out.
Apothecary Helbrim.label: Fist (Str)

Archmage Atiesh.name: Orrery Rod
Archmage Atiesh.flavor_text: A rod ringed with tiny rotating spheres. Each is a world; each is lit.

Archmage Atiesh.name: Observatory Star-Robes
Archmage Atiesh.flavor_text: Midnight cloth stitched with the actual night sky. One star is the wrong colour.

Archmage Atiesh.name: Spellblade-Guard Tower Shield
Archmage Atiesh.flavor_text: A flat plate of animated steel that swings to meet a blow before you do.

Archmage Atiesh.name: Waygate Shard Pendant
Archmage Atiesh.flavor_text: A violet sliver of the old waygate. Hold it, and you hear a door that isn't there.

Rethilgore.name: Rethilgore's Chain-Flail
Rethilgore.flavor_text: A hound-master's flail: three links, one heavy knot, and a lot of repeated use.

Rethilgore.name: Kennel-Master's Hide Coat
Rethilgore.flavor_text: Chewed at the hem by animals that stopped biting once they were in charge.

Rethilgore.name: Collar of the Lead Hound
Rethilgore.flavor_text: A studded collar. It still has a name engraved on the underside.

Rethilgore.name: Hound-Warden's Gauntlets
Rethilgore.flavor_text: Bite-proof plate, scarred by every dog in the keep.

Razorclaw the Butcher.name: Razorclaw's Meat-Cleaver
Razorclaw the Butcher.flavor_text: A two-handed cleaver with a hook for a handle-end. The hook sees plenty of use.

Razorclaw the Butcher.name: Butcher's Apron Leggings
Razorclaw the Butcher.flavor_text: Stiff with old stains and not quite as dry as they should be.

Razorclaw the Butcher.name: Hooked Chain Belt
Razorclaw the Butcher.flavor_text: A belt of S-hooks and short chain. Each hook has hung something.

Razorclaw the Butcher.name: Skinning-Knife Band
Razorclaw the Butcher.flavor_text: A thin band of steel sharpened on the inside. It is not a comfortable ring.

Baron Silverlaine.name: Silverlaine's Dress Sabre
Baron Silverlaine.flavor_text: A noble's sabre, thin and balanced, and entirely uninterested in dignity.

Baron Silverlaine.name: Baron's Moth-Eaten Mantle
Baron Silverlaine.flavor_text: Velvet and silver braid, gnawed by the heirs it outlived.

Baron Silverlaine.name: Hall-of-the-Damned Shield
Baron Silverlaine.flavor_text: A tall shield painted with a crest nobody left alive can read.

Baron Silverlaine.name: Signet of the Silverlaine Line
Baron Silverlaine.flavor_text: A cracked family ring. Its stone is the colour of old moonlight.

Fenrus the Devourer.name: Fenrus' Devouring Maw
Fenrus the Devourer.flavor_text: A two-handed maul with a jaw-shaped head. The teeth are real.

Fenrus the Devourer.name: Crypt-Stalker's Hide Vest
Fenrus the Devourer.flavor_text: Cured from something that fed in the crypt and did not feed lightly.

Fenrus the Devourer.name: Devourer's Bone-Plate Greaves
Fenrus the Devourer.flavor_text: Plate hammered over actual bone. The marrow's still warm.

Fenrus the Devourer.name: Mantle of the Hollow Pup
Fenrus the Devourer.flavor_text: A small grey cloak with a tiny hood. It is distressingly sized for the previous owner.

Archmage Arugal.name: Arugal's Voidcaller Staff
Archmage Arugal.flavor_text: The staff that opened the first door, and has been open ever since.

Archmage Arugal.name: Cloak of the Cursed Archmage
Archmage Arugal.flavor_text: Silver-grey wool with a moon-pattern that is, at certain angles, a wolf.

Archmage Arugal.name: Arugal's Shadow-Silk Robes
Archmage Arugal.flavor_text: Cut for a man who valued his reflection. It is no longer anywhere in the lining.

Archmage Arugal.name: Wolf-Fang Pendant of Arugal
Archmage Arugal.flavor_text: A fang carved with a spiral, strung on three strands of dark hair.
